scripts.ai: cd instrument-bridge && DEMO_SEED=1 uv run instrument-bridge ai-service
scripts.dev: concurrently --names "BACKEND,FRONTEND,AI" --prefix-colors "cyan,green,magenta" "npm run backend" "npm run frontend" "npm run ai"
